summary_en: Fiscal year ending March 2027 final dividend per share raised to 22 yen from 15 yen forecast in May 2026, reflecting better-than-expected earnings. Payout ratio targets approximately 30% including additional shareholder returns through dividends and buybacks.
title_en: Notice Regarding Revision of Expected Final Dividend for Fiscal Year Ending March 2027 (Dividend Hike)
translation_en_brief:
The Ogaki Kyoritsu Bank announced on November 13, 2026 that it has revised upward its forecast for the final dividend per share for the fiscal year ending March 31, 2027 from 15 yen to 22 yen, to be approved at the June 2027 general shareholders meeting. The revision reflects earnings performance exceeding the initial outlook. The bank noted that the amount reflects the impact of a 5-for-1 stock split effective October 1, 2026; on a split-unadjusted basis, the final dividend would be 110 yen.

The company maintains a basic policy of stable dividend distributions while maintaining sound management and strengthening financial position through retained earnings. Within that framework, the bank targets approximately 30% total payout ratio through stable base dividends supplemented by additional shareholder returns via dividend expansion and share buybacks. The dividend increase reflects comprehensive judgment of the fiscal 2027 earnings outlook, future capital adequacy ratios, and external environment.
